title: Autonomous Drone Swarm Coordination in GPS-Denied Tunnels
description: Investigating distributed consensus algorithms and visual-inertial SLAM for autonomous UAV swarms operating in subterranean environments without GPS availability.
required_skills: ROS2, C++, Python, OpenCV, Linear Algebra

title: Deep Learning for 3D Cardiac MRI Anomaly Segmentation
description: Developing hybrid vision transformer and convolutional networks for automated volumetric segmentation and real-time arrhythmia lesion detection from 3D MRI scans.
required_skills: PyTorch, Python, NumPy, Medical Imaging, CUDA

title: Quantum Error Correction Code Simulation on NISQ Devices
description: Benchmarking surface code and bosonic error correction fidelity against thermal and dephasing noise on simulated superconducting qubit architectures.

title: Zero-Trust Microsegmentation for Cloud-Native Kubernetes Clusters
description: Analyzing eBPF-based network telemetry to dynamically generate and enforce fine-grained ingress/egress firewall policies across container pods.
required_skills: Go, eBPF, Kubernetes, Linux Kernel, Wireshark

title: Perovskite Tandem Solar Cell Degradation Modeling
description: Simulating ion migration and environmental moisture degradation mechanisms in multi-junction perovskite-silicon solar cells under accelerated thermal cycling.
required_skills: COMSOL, Python, Finite Element Analysis, Solid State Physics
